speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to determine the underlying cause, please tell me your age and the duration of these symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Your history of ulcerative colitis and sexual activity with multiple partners raises concerns about infectious hepatitis or cholangitis; have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently? REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (ALT, AST, Alk Phos, Bilirubin), HCV RNA, HIV Ag/Ab, and Hepatitis A/B serology.

speaker: Doctor
text: The liver enzymes show a cholestatic pattern with significantly elevated alkaline phosphatase and mild transaminitis, while viral hepatitis markers are negative; given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you recently noticed any abdominal pain, change in bowel habits, or fever? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound and Autoimmune Liver Panel (ANA, ASMA, Anti-LKM, AMA).

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound confirms bile duct thickening and dilatation, which alongside your ulcerative colitis and negative autoimmune markers, strongly suggests Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. Do you experience any right upper quadrant abdominal pain, fever, or recent changes in your bowel movements? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.
